title: Salman @ Mohd. Salman v. Anil Kumar Garg, Executive Engineer
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
disposition: Prima facie contempt; one more month to decide the clause 6.14 application; contempt disposed with liberty to reapply.
headnote: In civil contempt alleging non-compliance with a 29 October 2018 direction to decide a U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 paragraph 6.14 installment application and to withhold coercive recovery, the Allahabad High Court held a prima facie case made out but afforded the Executive Engineer one further month to comply, disposing of the application with liberty to move afresh if the direction remained uncomplied.
facts: The consumer moved civil contempt against the Executive Engineer, PVVNL Deoband, for alleged wilful disobedience of the 29 October 2018 order in Writ-C No. 35827 of 2018. That writ had given him liberty to apply under paragraph 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 to pay the demand in installments, required a decision within a month, and stayed coercive steps on a 14 September 2018 recovery citation. He asserted that a certified copy was submitted but the application was not decided.

holding_units.holding: Finding a prima facie case of civil contempt for non-compliance of the 29 October 2018 direction to decide a paragraph 6.14 installment application and to withhold coercive recovery until that decision, the Court afforded the Executive Engineer one further month from production of a certified copy to comply, disposed of the contempt at that stage, and reserved liberty to the consumer to move a fresh application if the direction remained uncomplied.

not_decided.point: Merits of the clause 6.14 installment application and of the 14 September 2018 recovery citation
not_decided.note: The Court only enforced the prior direction to decide the application in accordance with law; it neither granted nor refused installments and did not examine the citation.

not_decided.point: Punishment under section 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971
not_decided.note: Despite a prima facie finding, the Court gave a further opportunity to comply and did not proceed to sentence.
